cloud_hypervisor_api_reboot.observed: firmware, fallback loader, kernel, root, SMBIOS credentials, CID and vsock returned, but the abrupt reset dirtied mounted filesystems and did not provide stable orderly-reboot readiness

secondary.defect: stock sshd -i session close status 255 was not declared successful, creating false failed-unit state
regular ssh.service was enabled despite no generic on-disk host keys, creating an unrelated failed unit
